Body.Content: The query authoring experience for Azure Stream Analytics jobs has been extended to enable query validation over sample data. Job queries can now be run against sample data from a local JSON file via the Test and Rerun buttons on the Query page of a Stream Analytics job to enable faster and more iterative development and debugging.
